name: Triage Inbox
install: pip3 install -r requirements.txt && npm --prefix web install

terminals.name: triage api
terminals.description: Local Triage Inbox API backend (server.py) on port 8000. Serves /api/health, /api/models, GitHub search/preview, and the live triage endpoint. Live triage/eval require an LLM API key (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY) in the environment.

terminals.name: web dashboard
terminals.description: Vite + React dashboard dev server on port 5173. Serves the static results bundle in web/public/data and proxies /api to the triage api on port 8000.
